rule_only.description: Regex + length checks only (--no-llm). No trained component.

prompt_engineering.description: 3-shot Claude Haiku judge: three labeled examples injected in system prompt. No fine-tuning.

simpo_judge_v1.description: SimPO-trained Qwen 3.5 0.8B + LoRA. Inference on Colab T4 (4-bit quantized).

delta_a.description: Accuracy gain: SimPO judge vs. rule-only baseline

delta_b.description: Accuracy gain: SimPO judge vs. prompt-engineering baseline
delta_b.note: CI lower bound near 0 — improvement is real but modest vs. strong few-shot baseline

claude_sonnet_api.note: Estimated upper bound — not run on held-out

key_findings: SimPO judge achieves +23.6pp over rule-only (McNemar p=0.004) — statistically significant
Largest gains on multithread-leakage (+70pp) and cost-pathology (+50pp) — categories requiring semantic reasoning that regex cannot provide
Dual-control gains +38pp — judge correctly handles compound flag interactions
Scheduling category unchanged (1.00) — pure format check, no semantic component
Cost parity: SimPO judge matches $0.00 cost of rule-only while closing 75% of the gap to Claude Sonnet API accuracy
Delta B (+14.5pp over prompt-engineering) is significant — fine-tuning outperforms few-shot at this task specificity
